 We’ve spent a year testing K-beauty buys, these are the ones that made our top spot – and have up to 57% off now
 Woman & Home Follow Sennen Prickett Sat, November 21, 2026 at 7:00 AM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Sat, November 21, 2026 at 7:00 AM UTC Lineup of our team's favourite K-beauty products that are on sale (L-R) from Beauty of Joseon, Dr Jart, Laniege and Anua, on a white background with 'loved by us' pink banner and circle image of team. When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission. 
 Credit: Future/Brands
 Anyone would agree that 2026 has been the year for K-beauty. With new Korean brands launching in our retailers each week, you can't miss it; it's everywhere right now.
 From affordable Amazon K-beauty skincare products to being stocked on the shelves of your nearest Boots store, it's never been easier to get your hands on Korea's innovative formulas. In fact, brands such as medicube, Biodance, and Beauty of Joseon have quickly gone on to become household names.
 Advertisement Advertisement While most K-beauty products are already on the affordable side, you're almost always guaranteed to find further discounts on said buys – even more so during sale periods, such as Black Friday, which is taking place right now. So, we've scoured the web and found impressive deals of up to 57% off our team's most favourite K-beauty buys...
